note: RECORD, not oracle — scoring recomputes live; regenerate this file after any build change

nodes.verdict_basis: risk_index is judged by birdsql:1151's own official gold SQL rerun LIVE on the bird_thrombosis_prediction_-prefixed book — a true single-row REAL scalar (an inpatient cohort ratio); the stored answer must equal the recipe's live result (its own CAST-text form) at scoring time

source_recipe.executed_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM bird_thrombosis_prediction_Patient WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'

nodes.follows: ratio-rounded-to-whole; rounding to a whole score is a declared change policy, no source counterpart

nodes.verdict_basis: change_volume is judged by birdsql:1023's own official gold SQL rerun LIVE on the bird_european_football_2_-prefixed book — a true single-row COUNT scalar; the cross-book input woven into the change arithmetic

source_recipe.executed_sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM bird_european_football_2_Player_Attributes WHERE overall_rating BETWEEN 60 AND 65 AND defensive_work_rate = 'low'

nodes.rule: window_uplift = change_volume*1000; release_total = risk_score + window_uplift; delta = window_uplift
nodes.follows: count-scaled-by-rate + additive combine; the per-change 1000 is a declared constant

nodes.rule: branch = 'EMERGENCY_HOLD' if risk_score>=100; 'EXTENDED_WINDOW' if risk_score>=20; else 'NORMAL_WINDOW'
nodes.follows: threshold-comparison-to-categorical-label CASE; the 20/100 bands are declared constants; the branch predicate is source-expressed (risk_score from the live thrombosis book)

nodes.verdict_basis: fixed-slot calendar event creation judged by the resulting row; the [CM-WINDOW] window's duration is the declared 3-day change window
net-amount judging follows appworld:train/60d0b5b_1 — a wrong disbursement corrected by an offsetting transaction, never a delete; the net target is the recomputed delta

nodes.rule: one [CM-HANDOFF] email owner->partner citing release_total+delta, present IFF branch in EXTENDED_WINDOW/EMERGENCY_HOLD
nodes.follows: appworld:train/29caf6f_1 evaluator's send-a-message-whose-body-is-computed assert; the AppWorld pool has no email-send task, so the gm_emails assert is composition glue with an iff-branch guard

nodes.verdict_basis: single CRM field write judged by the resulting row; the field is notes and the stamp is the [CM-LOG] release_total marker

nodes.follows: appworld:train/3c13f5a_1 evaluator's equal-split assert; the AppWorld pool has no Splitwise task, so the sw_expenses assert is composition glue

nodes.rule: one [CM-FUP] task citing delta in the owner's project, gated on the CRM log
nodes.follows: workbench:project_mgmt/10 task-create outcome form, asserted via the AppWorld table-state pattern

nodes.verdict_basis: dedicated CRM status write; the value is bound to the re-derived tier
nodes.rule: tier = 'EMERGENCY_CHANGE' if the live risk score >= 100; 'EXTENDED_REVIEW' if >= 20; else 'STANDARD_CHANGE'; re-derived live (type-C, never in answers)
nodes.follows: threshold banding on a live source aggregate (the thrombosis inpatient ratio), not a relabel of a stored value
inputs: risk score <- live bird_thrombosis_prediction (re-derived at write time)

nodes.verdict_basis: EnterpriseOps-Gym gym-itsm-mcp oracle task (raise a standard change so the deployment can be managed during the change window): its first two native database_state checks — the CHG_026 standard change record and its CRM_017 mapping to the incident it remediates — are inherited VERBATIM (prefix rewrite only, byte-identical, expected/comparison untouched); the dependency coupling (the change summary line citing the tier that matches the CRM [CM-TIER] stamp and the live re-derivation) is a SEPARATE composition glue check on the same node
nodes.rule: the change record == the source task's own change + mapping checks, filed at the n12 tier relay and citing it
inputs: tier relay <- n12 CRM [CM-TIER] (must equal the live re-derivation)

nodes.verdict_basis: EnterpriseOps-Gym gym-itsm-mcp oracle task: its incident-hold check (INC_057 on_hold, reason 'Awaiting Change', change_request CHG_026) is inherited VERBATIM; the coupling (the work note carrying the change number and the tier off the change record's summary line) is a SEPARATE composition glue check
nodes.rule: the production incident is held against the filed change and its work note carries that change's number + tier
inputs: tier word <- n13 eops_gym_itsm_mcp_change [CM-CHG] summary line (quoted in the work note)
gate <- n13 change CHG0000026 filed (register-state gate)

nodes.rule: one [CM-STATUS] email owner->CAB lead citing release_total + the live tier + the held incident, gated on that hold
nodes.follows: appworld:train/29caf6f_1 evaluator's message-send assert; no email-send task in the AppWorld pool
inputs: held incident <- n14 eops_gym_itsm_mcp_incident work note (INC-000057)

nodes.verdict_basis: EnterpriseOps-Gym gym-itsm-mcp oracle task: its caller-notification check (NOTIF_031, type 'update', on INC_057 to the incident's caller of record) is inherited VERBATIM; the coupling (the message repeating the release total exactly as reported in the [CM-STATUS] update) is a SEPARATE composition glue check
nodes.rule: the caller of record is told the fix rides this change, the notice repeating the reported release_total + tier
inputs: release_total as reported <- n15 gm_emails [CM-STATUS] body

nodes.verdict_basis: EnterpriseOps-Gym gym-itsm-mcp oracle task: its SLA-pause check (TSLA_022 on INC_057 at stage 'paused') is inherited VERBATIM; the coupling (the caller notification filed first) is a SEPARATE composition glue check
nodes.rule: the held incident's SLA clock is paused for the window, never before the caller is told
inputs: gate <- n16 eops_gym_itsm_mcp_notification NOTIF_031 update to the caller (register-state gate)

nodes.verdict_basis: CRM field write judged by the resulting row; the reconcile verdict is bound to the vm ledger net
nodes.rule: reconciled = 'ok' iff the [CM-FEE] net (disbursements - reversals) to the correct vendor == delta, with the CRM [CM-RECON] note citing delta

nodes.verdict_basis: conditional, conflict-free first-free-slot 30-minute booking; the slot grid starts at the end of the [CM-WINDOW] window (type-B, read off the calendar) and the gate is the CRM reconcile note + the eops Teams channel

side_exposure is judged by birdsql:182's own official gold SQL rerun LIVE on the bird_-prefixed financial book — a true single-row COUNT scalar (no region/A3 clause); an independent side question no downstream check reads

source_recipe.executed_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.account_id) FROM bird_trans AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN bird_disp AS T4 ON T2.account_id = T4.account_id INNER JOIN bird_client AS T3 ON T4.client_id = T3.client_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T3.birth_date) BETWEEN '1974' AND '1976' AND T3.gender = 'M' AND T1.amount > 4000 AND T1.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
